t: Aluminium construction. Classic espagnolette offset locking window handle with a contemporary twist suitable for timber and most uPVC casement windows. Coordinates with Perfectly Matching range. Greater leverage and ease of operation assured with handle's curvy design, long lever and ergonomically designed button. Heavy duty sprung latch wedge creating a positive click upon closing. With key deadlocking for security, the key clicks into place when inserted and will remain in place when pivoting the lever. For replacing existing handles the 40mm spindle size is ideal as the slotted spindle allows cropping to 5mm increments.
